question: Should this PR land with provider-qualified aliases taking precedence over same-provider direct model ids when the suffix matches a configured alias?
rationale: The diff fixes the canonical bug at the shared resolver boundary, but that precedence is a compatibility-sensitive model-routing choice that automation should not silently own.

options.title: Accept alias precedence
options.body: Merge once required checks finish, treating provider/Alias as an intentional alias form when the provider matches the alias target.

options.title: Require direct-id precedence
options.body: Ask for a resolver-order change and regression test if direct provider/model ids must always beat aliases with the same suffix.

options.title: Pause for broader picker policy
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want to solve all Control UI display-value canonicalization cases together instead of landing the alias-specific fix now.

recommendation.title: Accept alias precedence
recommendation.body: Merge once required checks finish, treating provider/Alias as an intentional alias form when the provider matches the alias target.
